title: Nourishing Molten Kenyan Pilaf
description: A soothing, earthy, and comforting pilaf perfect for sick days. Raspberry jam adds a sweet and tangy twist to this keto-friendly dish from Kenya.
instructions: Place the wooden board in the oven and warm it for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the chicken broth, diced carrots, and sliced sweet potatoes.
Pour the mixture onto the warmed wooden board and arrange the onions, ginger, cinnamon, and black pepper on top.
Drizzle the coconut oil over the mixture and spread it evenly.
Bake for 25 minutes, then stir in the raspberry jam.
Reduce heat to 350°F (175°C) and cover with parchment paper sealed with foil, creating a papillote.
Return to the oven and bake for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Slice into portions and serve hot.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
